message.content:
**Signatures on the U.S. Declaration of Independence**

| Signer | State / Colony |
|--------|----------------|
| **John Hancock** – *President of the Continental Congress* | Massachusetts |
| **Thomas McKean** | Pennsylvania |
| **George Clymer** | Pennsylvania |
| **Robert Morris** | Pennsylvania |
| **Benjamin Rush** | Pennsylvania |
| **James Smithson** | Maryland |
| **William Paca** | Maryland |
| **Samuel Chase** | Maryland |
| **Charles Carroll** | Maryland |
| **Francis Hopkinson** | New Jersey |
| **David Rittenhouse** | New Jersey |
| **Richard Henry Lee** | Virginia |
| **Edward Rutledge** | South Carolina |
| **Henry Laurens** | South Carolina |
| **Joseph Hewes** | North Carolina |
| **Moses Fleetwood Walker** | Rhode Island |
| **Stephen Hopkins** | Rhode Island |
| **Roger Sherman** | Connecticut |
| **Oliver Wolcott** | Connecticut |
| **Lewis Morris** | New York |
| **Philip Schuyler** | New York |
| **Benedict Arnold** | New York |
| **Ethan Allen** | Vermont (then part of NY) |
| **John Adams** | Massachusetts |
| **Paul Revere** | Massachusetts |
| **Elijah Haskins** | Massachusetts |
| **Nathaniel Whitaker** | Massachusetts |
| **John Witherspoon** | New Jersey |
| **Abraham Clark** | New Hampshire |
| **Josiah Bartlett** | New Hampshire |
| **Matthew Thornton** | New Hampshire |
| **John Hart** | Delaware |
| **Gideon Putnam** | Delaware |
| **George Read** | Delaware |
| **George Washington** | District of Columbia (later president) |

> **Key points**
>
> - A total of **56 men** signed the document when it was adopted on **July 2, 1776**, though only 39 were present at the signing ceremony on **August 2, 1776**.  
> - Some states had multiple representatives because each colony sent several delegates to the Continental Congress.  
> - Notable early signers include **John Hancock** (whose bold signature became emblematic), **Thomas Jefferson** (author of the draft), **Benjamin Franklin**, and **Alexander Hamilton** (who did not sign).  

If you’d like more detail about any particular signer—biography, role in the Revolution, or why their signature mattered—just let me know!
